notes.title: Who doesn't love a good carrot?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34491490/954be76652492262b5d825a9f339eadb1d860af5.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

Ah, springtime. It really puts us in a pleasant mood. The warm sun, the green grass, all the adorable frolicking animals… Speaking of which, we've got something that should put quite a spring in your step - it's Nimh's new pinup!

Seriously, gardening has never looked so good. We're mad as March hares over those bunny ears, not to mention that rather mischievous-looking carrot. What a way to get your daily 4-5 servings of vegetables, am I right?

And now, because we can, it's time for some radish veggie puns: this pinup is kind of a big dill, so turnip each day to collect your tokens. We're rooting for you, and we know it'll knock your stalks off, so remember - once you unlock your reward, there's no need to romaine calm. Shout and sing if you peas! In fact, lettuce all have an upbeet celebration in the name of love.

Because we olive you so hard!

- The Pandas

notes.title: Will You Be Our Valentine?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34491490/dc5650860a489193618ae19e7e0f52df83b83f96.png[/img]
Happy Valentine's Week, Panda Peeps!

In honor of this special time, here's a list of things we love:
[list]
[*] You (SO HARD)
[*] Love, in general
[*] Hawt guys
[*] Hawt guys who love us
[*] Hawt guys who love each other
[*] Our animal friends <3
[/list]

And last but not least…

[list]
[*] [b]Sales events![/b]
[/list]

Wooo! Welcome to our Valentine’s Day sale! From February 11-16, enjoy 10% off Diamonds in the Store. Not just that - DLC bundles are 10% off too! That includes the adorable Sven Bundle, the chilling Cole Bundle, and the wonderful Voice Bundle!

What better way to celebrate love, affection, and tingly feelings than with the Blush Blush boys? Enjoy the sale, have a great week, and remember…

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: Daylight Saving Time and LTE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34491490/c181b4ac9be1b7d93ed49b09d7be93a46dc00475.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Just a quick reminder that some of you might be changing your clocks this weekend!  That means that depending on where you live you might find the Limited Time Event switches over at a different time than you are used to.  That's because our LTE uses a time zone that isn't affected by Daylight Saving Time!
 
Hope you're enjoying the outfit event that's going on :)

Happy Halloween~
- the Pandas

notes.title: Things in the works
notes.content:
Hey Blushing Baes,

It's been an exciting week for Blush Blush! We just got a huge surge of new peeps playing the game (thanks to a certain charming Youtuber), at the same time we've been finishing up a bunch of internal work for the game's future releases. Noice!

Whether you're new to Blush Blush, or a veteran of the man-imal quest, you might be wondering what's around the corner. The game has been in Beta for a few months, and so far we've been making updates on the slow-ish side, as we wrap up a bunch of details.

Well, we're here to reveal our evil plans! Only they're not evil - they're scandalous at best. Either way, here's a list of our timeline and features that you can expect coming up in the next couple months:
[list]
[*] New character! Putting the "goat" in "GOAT", early next month we'll be adding "William" to the cast. He's a sexy veterinarian who's a little more on the sophisticated side. 

[*] Endless levels!  Looking to keep working on your Reset Bonus and earn some extra diamonds? Next month we'll be adding an "Endless" option to the boys, so you can keep woo-ing them without the pesky interruption of them being completely in love with you. 

[*] End of Early Access! While we still have a few boys and surprises in store, we'll be making some final tweaks to the gameplay and balance before coming out of Early Access. What does that mean for you? Well, it means…

[*] Mobile edition! We'll be launching Blush Blush on mobile in the next two months(ish)! Look to flirt with your favorite fellas on your phone! So cute!

[*] End of Early Access also means some upgrades for artwork, including milestones, pinups, outfits and…
 
[*] Phone Flings! We've got a bunch of fun and flirty guys almost ready, who'll be fighting for your attention. And if you don't know what a "Phone Fling" is - they're awesome little side stories where you can chat with guys and earn some selfies!

[/list]

We crazy appreciate all our fans, new and experienced, and hope you'll all continue to support Blush Blush as we finish up our dress rehearsal and move onto the big show. 

Thanks for everything. Keep sending us your ideas, and stay tuned for more surprises and fun stuff. 

Love you all so hard!
--
The Pandas
